source: Owner direct chat after MSQ-52 completion
owner_message_original: Делай коммит после закрытия задачи пожалуйста всегда
owner_message_english_translation: Please always make a commit after closing a task.
decision: Make a local Git commit of verified task-scoped changes after each task closure, before the final owner handoff.
scope: Standing project workflow instruction, including the just-completed MSQ-52 and Datum16 selection.
responsibility: The controller creates the closure commit; a worker may do so only when explicitly delegated.
preservation: Keep unrelated owner edits out of the task commit, retain Git LFS for binary assets, and never commit credentials or generated diagnostic data.
